blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Less than a month after the conclusion of the 2026 bar examination, the Supreme Court (SC) has released the syllabus and schedule for next year’s exam. In Bar Bulletin No. 1-2027, SC Associate Justice Ricardo Rosario, chairperson of the 2027 bar examination, told aspiring lawyers that the exam will be a test of character and competence rather than mere memorization. “The bar is an important gate, but it is not the whole road,” Rosario stated. “Remember that the Court is far from looking for those who can recall the most laws or rules verbatim, for a computer can do […]...
